ranged_superglide: Prior Final visual/passive windows and native movement retained.

ranged_aerial_hold: Sanitized attack NoGravity window; current height held during the combo, then native fall restored; no ability/defensive grant.
native_spell_logic: KH1 MP/levels/projectiles/effects/damage retained, with v10 cast observer fix.
style_exclusivity: Equip either to disable previous style; no extra native abilities.
